d:
EICMA 2026 saw a big showing from Indian manufacturers, with exciting new motorcycles, global ambitions and plenty of action in the middleweight segment. On this week's episode of Deep Drive, powered by Kotak Mahindra Prime, Rishaad Mody and Ketan Thakkar discuss the biggest highlights from the show. They also discuss the growing Chinese competition, the impact of 40% GST on premium motorcycles and what lies ahead for India's two-wheeler industry.
Views expressed in this podcast belong solely to the speakers.
